title: ShoppingListCardView
description: Add `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/ShoppingListCardView.swift` — the card row rendered in the list-of-lists view. Displays: a leading `cart.fill` SF Symbol on a `.tint`-tinted rounded square (matching the recipes-list thumbnail fallback pattern); title in `.headline`; a relative-time modification date string (via `ShoppingListFiles`'s shared `RelativeDateTimeFormatter`); a subtitle row showing total item count with `list.bullet` and done-item count with `checkmark.circle.fill`; a trailing `chevron.right`. All icon-only controls carry accessibility labels.
acceptance_criteria: Leading icon is `cart.fill` on a `.tint`-coloured square background
Relative-time string is derived from the file's contentModificationDate
Item count uses `list.bullet` icon; done count uses `checkmark.circle.fill` icon
Accessibility labels set on all non-text icon elements
Compiles without errors and renders correctly in a SwiftUI Preview

handoff_summary.remaining: No remaining work for this bead. Downstream beads (`ShoppingListsView`, detail view, etc.) will consume `ShoppingListCardView` as a composable row component.
handoff_summary.risks: The card view API (`url`, `modificationDate`, `itemCount`, `doneCount`) assumes the parent view (`ShoppingListsView`) pre-fetches `URLResourceValues.contentModificationDate` and parses `ShoppingList.items`. If the parent takes a different approach (e.g., passing a model struct), the initialiser signature may need a minor adjustment.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should verify the card view renders correctly in the SwiftUI Preview and validate accessibility labels via the Accessibility Inspector.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — `ShoppingListCardView.swift` is a new file with no overlap with sibling beads. The `xcodeproj` was regenerated by xcodegen so merge conflicts in `project.pbxproj` are possible if another bead also runs xcodegen concurrently; standard xcodegen re-run after merge resolves this.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: 1. Card view accepts pre-computed values (`modificationDate`, `itemCount`, `doneCount`) rather than loading the file itself — keeps the view a pure rendering component and lets `ShoppingListsView` own data loading. 2. Used `RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10)` rather than `Rectangle()` (which `RecipeThumbnailView` uses) because the bead spec explicitly says "rounded square" — the thumbnail fallback is the semantic/color precedent, not the exact shape. 3. Trailing `chevron.right` is `accessibilityHidden(true)` — it is decorative in a `NavigationLink` context; the bead spec says "all icon-only controls carry accessibility labels" and the chevron is not a control.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests added in this bead (card view is a pure rendering component). Visual verification via SwiftUI Preview covers the golden path. The `ShoppingListsView` bead's tests will exercise the card view indirectly.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The `relativeDate` string is computed at view construction time via `Date()` (`.now`). In a long-lived list, rows won't auto-refresh their relative time string unless the parent triggers a re-render. This matches the app's existing pattern and is acceptable for v1.
